pdf.question: What is the best initial test for hepatitis C, and what confirms a positive result?
pdf.reference_answer: Hepatitis C antibody is the best initial test; if positive, PCR is the most accurate test.

pdf.question: How is spontaneous bacterial peritonitis diagnosed and treated?
pdf.reference_answer: Diagnosis by paracentesis, cell count over 250 neutrophils; treatment IV cefotaxime and albumin.

pdf.question: Which drug prevents bleeding from esophageal varices in cirrhosis?
pdf.reference_answer: Propranolol (banding if it is already bleeding).

pdf.question: What is the treatment for Wilson's disease and what is the best initial test?
pdf.reference_answer: Penicillamine; best initial tests are slit lamp (Kayser-Fleischer rings) and ceruloplasmin level.

pdf.question: What fasting transferrin saturation and ferritin values count as a positive screen for hereditary hemochromatosis?
pdf.reference_answer: Fasting transferrin saturation above 45%, and fasting ferritin above 250 ug/L on more than one occasion.

video.question: What is the difference between a Docker image and a container?
video.reference_answer: An image is the recipe (ingredients and instructions); a container is the actual meal made from it, and one image can create many containers.
video.reference_basis: transcript read by Claude, segment starting 1:32

video.question: Why does the Dockerfile install dependencies before copying the rest of the code?
video.reference_answer: Layer caching: if a layer has not changed Docker reuses the cache, so dependencies are not re-downloaded each time the code changes, making builds faster.

video.question: What is the difference between RUN and CMD in a Dockerfile?
video.reference_answer: RUN happens when building the image; CMD is what Docker uses to start the container.

video.question: What does Docker Scout do?
video.reference_answer: It looks inside an image, lists its packages, checks them for vulnerabilities and suggests how to fix them.

video.question: How much faster can Docker Build Cloud make builds?
video.reference_answer: Up to 39 times faster (builds happen in the cloud, and a team can share the cache).
